title: Obstacles to Continuous Quantum Error Correction via Parity Measurements
summary: Time-continuous quantum error correction, necessary to protect quantum information under time-dependent Hamiltonians, relies on weak continuous syndrome measurements. Implementing these measurements requires a continuous coupling among at least two qubits and a meter, a demanding requirement. We show that, under continuous operation, common parity-measurement protocols in the circuit quantum electrodynamics platform corrupt the logical information.
